content.text: Simplest: define a local `Fill = string | Paint`.

input.command: cd samples && sed -i 's|^import type { ColorInput } from "../src/paint";|import type { Paint } from "../src/paint";|; s/ColorInput/Fill/g' lanternShrine.ts && sed -i 's|^type Pt = \[number, number, number\];|type Fill = string \| Paint;\ntype Pt = [number, number, number];|' lanternShrine.ts && sed -i '/const PINK = cel/d; /const CERAMIC = cel/d' lanternShrine.ts && cd .. && npm run typecheck -- lanternShrine 2>&1 | tail -40
